title: Correct acceleration value
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be 1 m/s².

title: Correct time value
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must be 2√3 s.

title: Correct velocity value
description: Essential: The final answer for part (3) must be 2√3 m/s.

title: Net force analysis
description: Important: The solution must correctly resolve gravity along the incline and apply Newton's second law (mg sinθ - F_f = ma).

title: Kinematics application
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply the kinematic equations for constant acceleration (L = ½at² and v = at) to find time and final velocity.

title: Trigonometric ratio identification
description: Important: The solution must correctly identify sinθ = h/L to find the component of gravity down the slope.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: All calculated quantities should be presented with correct units.

title: Sign error in force equation
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the friction force is incorrectly added to the gravitational component (mg sinθ + F_f = ma).

title: Incorrect kinematic equation
description: Pitfall: Penalize if an incorrect kinematic equation (e.g., using v² = u² + 2aL with u=0 to find time) is used, leading to an algebraic error.
